answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents anchor identity in a cryptographic attestation chain verified via zero-knowledge proofs. Registering identities requires locking stake in a collateral vault where each additional registration by linked clusters imposes an exponential capital exhaustion penalty: the cost delta scales superlinearly as $O(k^n)$. A malicious gale of synthetic clones rapidly depletes reserves, rendering swarm generation economically unviable.
